stories.title: Rename app Vyaapar -> MSW Global
stories.accept: No user-facing 'Vyaapar/Vyapar' remains; brand reads 'MSW Global' in tab, sidebar, login, POS header, platform portal.

stories.title: Auto-refresh data lists (no manual reload)
stories.accept: Adding a product and returning to POS or refocusing the tab shows it without a hard reload.

stories.title: Party supplier saved as customer
stories.accept: Creating a party as Supplier persists partyType=SUPPLIER and shows under Suppliers.

stories.title: Password strength on staff-create + eye everywhere
stories.accept: Weak staff passwords rejected client-side with a clear message; every password field has a working eye toggle.

stories.title: Add-category UI for items + expenses
stories.accept: User can create a new item category and expense category from their forms and select it immediately; backend auto-slugs and handles duplicates.

stories.title: Credit settle: collect payment (unpaid -> paid)
stories.accept: From a credit customer's page, one action records payment and the balance/invoice flips toward PAID.

stories.title: Product return button in UI
stories.accept: From a completed sale an authorized user can issue a return; invoice shows REFUNDED and balances update.

stories.title: Payroll all staff/branches + advance/custom salary
stories.accept: One Generate run covers every active staff member across entities; user can pay an advance or set a custom amount.

stories.title: RBAC Super Admin / Manager / Biller scoping + route guards
stories.accept: Biller reaches only POS + today's sales (no P&L), redirected elsewhere; Manager sees all features for assigned shop(s) only; Super Admin sees everything.

stories.title: Barcode 2-up print + thermal bill customization
stories.accept: User can print 2 barcode slips from the items page; Settings lets them customize the thermal bill and the printed receipt reflects it.
